grade: C- provisional - playable basic Snake; self-collision and reversal protection fail; calibration only
strengths: Independent exact-source checks pass startup, keyboard movement, timed play, button pause/resume, restart and wall collision. No external resources are required.
A controlled food pickup grows the snake from three to four cells, awards ten points and raises speed from 6 to 7.4 cells/sec at level two. Moving into a vacating tail cell is permitted.
defects: The occupancy Set removes the old tail on ordinary moves but never adds the new head. After a legal right/right/right/down/left/up sequence, the snake overlaps its recent body at(10,8) and continues running instead of ending the game.
queueDir compares an opposite-direction string to state.dir, which is an object. Reversal is therefore accepted; pressing Left immediately after starting Right kills the game against its own body.

spawnFood runs before occupancy is rebuilt following growth. A controlled random-choice fixture places the new food on the newly added head. This fixture proves an invalid placement is possible, not its frequency during random play.
